posts.text: Everything is trade offs. Life is a series of trade offs.

What are the implications of this?


🇦🇪 HGS (@Sajwani)

Today the UAE 🇦🇪 officially leaves OPEC … it’s a new world !

Never bet against the UAE



— https://nitter.net/Sajwani/status/2050067215488274811#m

The answers to many modern problems are simple but politically incorrect.

So instead of solving anything, everybody pretends they don't know what's going on, and spend years misdiagnosing the issue, talking in circles, and wasting time.

If enough people see your social media post, you will receive some negative comments. 

It doesn't matter how positive or uncontroversial the post is... If enough people see it, somebody will come and start hating in the comment section.
If you don't have a sense of humour then life is going to be particularly rough for you.
What makes you believe a statistic?
Just received this email... Seems legit.
The world is actually a lot safer than it was 30 years ago but 24/7 news and social media have convinced everybody otherwise.

Massive shout out to everybody doing their best to raise upright, competent children.

You are literally securing the future of mankind. May God bless you, wherever you are.
Some of the most important life metrics cannot be measured quantitatively.

I am yet to find any children's toy that is more versatile and engaging than a random cardboard box or empty plastic bottle.

I am increasingly convinced that baby and toddler toys are to make the parents feel good. Kind of like designer baby clothes.

🥲

I believe that most taxation is theft and it should be eliminated.

I also believe that if taxes are to exist (and they do in most places), they should be spent wisely to the benefit of the population.

High taxes + bad public infrastructure & services is the worst of both worlds

This is why the terms 'people of colour' and 'white privilege' are very stupid.

(and divisive... perhaps intentionally)

With @Sargon_of_Akkad
